subtype: faithful implementation of an insufficient story rule; footgun (Law 3 in scope)
storyTag: story-001 (rule) -> breaks story-002 acceptance and src/CLAUDE.md invariants
severity: potential-low (carried by CODE-001; do not double-count)
specText: story-001 Technical Details: "`setRoute` validates `path[0] == token` ... It also checks that the last non-zero entry of `path` equals `sya.rewardToken()` ... Use the CurveAMMAdapter loop as the template."  versus  src/CLAUDE.md: "Route coverage invariant ... otherwise the harvest reverts rather than stranding tokens in the contract" / "The contract holds no balances between calls" and story-002 Acceptance: "After a successful harvest the contract holds zero balances of every token."
specSource: story-001 doc (Technical Details > Contract surface); story-002 doc Acceptance; src/CLAUDE.md Design decisions
actualBehavior: setRoute implements story-001's last-non-zero rule exactly. Router NG stops at the first zero pool slot, so a path with an interior gap passes validation, delivers the intermediate token (crvUSD in the CODE-001 fork run) and strands it permanently. The harvest still succeeds and harvest.sh sends it.
deviation: Faithful to story-001, but story-001's rule cannot uphold the invariants that story-002 and CLAUDE.md promise. The story's validation is the root cause, so a fix has to amend the story's rule as well as the code. MockCurveRouter copies the same rule (CODE-007(2)), which hides the problem in the unit tests.
law1Assessment: Law 1 overrides Law 2: the faithful implementation is still a defect. The owner registering a gapped route is a non-obvious owner footgun, because the validator is presented as the route-end guard. Impact: silent, recurring stranding of the caller's paid-for yield. No third-party theft.
recommendation: As in CODE-001: require contiguity (the first empty pool slot k gives path[2k]==rewardToken, with everything after it zero). Also add an end-of-callback zero-balance assertion and make MockCurveRouter follow Router NG semantics.
label: F-02
